name: agent-template
description: Deployable agent: harness, tools, guardrails, memory and observability in one repo.
comment: mcporter is a dependency rather than a global install because pi resolves an extension's imports from the node_modules beside it. A global install would leave `import { createRuntime } from 'mcporter'` unresolvable at run time — and the failure would only appear once a job actually declared an MCP server.
